claim: Aurora Auto Scaling scales a DB cluster only if all cluster instances are in the available state.

values.display: only scales a DB cluster if all cluster instances are in the available state

evidence.quote: Aurora Auto Scaling only scales a DB cluster if all cluster instances are in the available state.

claim: When Aurora Auto Scaling adds a new Aurora Replica, the new replica has the same DB instance class as the primary instance.

values.display: same DB instance class as the one used by the primary instance

evidence.quote: When Aurora Auto Scaling adds a new Aurora Replica, the new Aurora Replica is the same DB instance class as the one used by the primary instance.

claim: The promotion tier for replicas added by Aurora Auto Scaling is set to the last priority, which is 15 by default, so a replica with a better priority is promoted first during a failover.
question: What promotion tier do replicas added by Aurora Auto Scaling get?

values.display: last priority, which is 15 by default
promotion tier for new Aurora Replicas

qualifiers.scope: per Aurora Replica added by Aurora Auto Scaling

evidence.quote: Also, the promotion tier for new Aurora Replicas is set to the last priority, which is 15 by default.
This means that during a failover, a replica with a better priority, such as one created manually, would be promoted first.
